en.headline: Six men arrested after police dismantle social-media cannabis trafficking group
en.dek: About 7.7 kg of suspected cannabis buds and related products valued at more than HK$1.9 million were seized in raids on bases and stores in Tsuen Wan and Yuen Long.
body: Police arrested six local men aged between 22 and 52 on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs and conspiracy to traffic after dismantling a group that sold cannabis products via social media platforms.

Under an operation code-named “Ling Kwong”, officers located an operations base in a commercial building in Tsuen Wan and storage sites in Tsuen Wan and Yuen Long. About 7.7 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds together with cannabis-related products were seized, with a total estimated market value of more than HK$1.9 million.

Police said the group had used an Instagram account that promoted cannabis culture and provided Telegram and WhatsApp ordering links. The suspects included the alleged mastermind, customer-service staff, warehouse keepers and a courier. The case will be brought before court.

zh.headline: 警拘6男瓦解社交平台販毒集團 檢值190萬元大麻花
zh.dek: 行動中於荃灣及元朗搗破行動基地及儲存倉，檢獲約7.7公斤懷疑大麻花及相關產品，市值超過190萬元。
body: 警方以「販運危險藥物」及「串謀販運危險藥物」罪拘捕6名年齡介乎22至52歲本地男子，瓦解一個透過社交平台販賣大麻產品的集團。
在代號「凜光」的行動中，人員於荃灣一商業大廈搗破行動基地，以及荃灣和元朗的毒品儲存倉，檢獲約7.7公斤懷疑大麻花及大量大麻相關產品，市值超過港幣190萬元。
警方指該集團利用Instagram帳戶發佈吹噓吸食大麻的貼文，並提供Telegram頻道及WhatsApp落單連結。被捕人士包括主腦、客服職員、倉庫管理人及派送員。案件稍後提堂。
